Mutations 1 to 13 are the follower's decisions: which package is the runtime, how versions compare, the five ways a run cannot be judged, and the one issue it opens, updates and closes. 14 to 19 are the pin test's questions, one each, and 19 is the count that keeps it from passing on a workflow it never read. 20 to 22 are the fact itself: the workflow's value, the doctor's read, the strict parse of the constant.
